subject: Holistic Progress Cards for Siddhartha Multipurpose School (English), Kharghar – ready before March
text:
Dear Principal,

This year every school has to give parents a Holistic Progress Card in the PARAKH (NCERT) format under NEP 2020. For most teachers, filling these by hand for every student takes many hours.

CampusOne, a Navi Mumbai school software company, has built a Holistic 360° Profile system that makes this simple for Siddhartha Multipurpose School (English):

- Complete cards for all stages, Nursery to Class X, in your school's own format
- Teachers enter an activity once for the whole class, then set each student's level on one screen
- Parents and students fill their own sections from their phone, straight into the teacher's screen
- The year-end summary fills itself from term assessments, with a draft comment for every student
- Print or save every card as PDF with your school's name, in one click

You can read more about the system, and why schools are moving beyond marks to 360° student profiles, in this article on First Education News:

https://firsteducationnews.com/article.asp?id=65618

Starting now with Term 2 means your teachers finish comfortably before March.

May I show you a free 20-minute demo at your school this week? We can also run a free 30-day pilot with one class so your teachers can try it first.

Please reply with a convenient day, or call or WhatsApp me on 98673 81971.

Regards,
Team CampusOne
CampusOne Education Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
98673 81971 | 88500 93759 | info@campusone.in | https://campusone.in/

If you would rather not receive emails from us, just reply "No thanks" and we will not write again.
